Based on **ADR-003** (active decision from 2026-05-20, `docs/project-knowledge/decisions/ADR-003-hold-seats-with-queue.md`):

**How it holds a seat:** A hold is a position in a per-seat queue. The `holdSeat` function in the booking component enqueues the user.

**For how long:** The hold **does not expire on its own**. It persists indefinitely until either:
1. The user explicitly releases the hold, or
2. The head of the queue confirms their hold (which moves the next user to the head)

This replaced the previous TTL-based approach (ADR-001) because it was losing seats when users were still in checkout when the timer ran out. The current queue mechanism ensures a fair position—once you have a hold, you keep your place without racing a clock, limited only by the constraint that each user can hold only one seat at a time.

The booking service holds a seat by placing the user in a **per-seat queue** with **no expiration timer**.

From [[decisions/ADR-003-hold-seats-with-queue]]: A hold is a position in the queue. The head of the queue may confirm; the rest wait. The hold is released only when the user explicitly releases it, or when it reaches the head and the user confirms it (moves it to a booking).

**Hold duration:** There is no automatic expiration. A hold persists indefinitely until:
- The user confirms it (charge and complete the booking)
- The user releases it manually
- A new hold by the same user is placed (this releases the previous hold, per [[constraints/constraint-single-hold-per-user]])

This replaced the earlier TTL-based approach ([[decisions/ADR-001-hold-seats-with-ttl]]) which caused support issues when users' TTLs expired mid-checkout. The queue ensures fairness: every user gets a position, and nobody loses a seat to a clock.

Sources: [[decisions/ADR-003-hold-seats-with-queue]], [[domain/domain-hold-lifecycle]], [[components/booking]]

The booking service holds a seat **indefinitely** via a queue position—not a timer.

This replaced a TTL approach (ADR-001) because users lost seats mid-checkout when the timer ran out. ([[decisions/ADR-003-hold-seats-with-queue]])
